description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Your owner's live farms: each farm's status (queued, deposited, exiting, no_route), amount, what is deposited and its transaction, earned so far (0 until a token lands), and the farm wallet's state. From EventTrader's Airdrop Farmer (cymetica.com/airdrop-farmer): one amount split across airdrop farms of protocols with no token yet; a farm is listed only after its token has no market and its own points or testnet page was read with the programme running. One farm wallet per person, never pooled; the owner's own coins pay every fee. No airdrop is promised.
name: airdrop_farm_live
title: Airdrop Farm Live
